title: Czech Koruna: Dovish CNB may weaken CZK against Euro - ING
summary: ING strategist Frantisek Taborsky outlines a busy Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) data calendar but stresses that the Czech National Bank (CNB) meeting is the key event. He expects rates to stay at 3.75% with dovish guidance, contrasting with still-hawkish market pricing.

title: Gold starts the week lower as traders await Fed verdict
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) kicks off the week on a bearish note as Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike expectations dominate market sentiment ahead of the two-day monetary policy meeting starting on Tuesday.
